handoffs.name: Splash reveals underwater
handoffs.mechanism: The impacting drop creates a rising wave/splash contour; the fish keeps moving behind the changing water coverage.

handoffs.name: A nudge sends the light toward the leaf
handoffs.mechanism: The fish contacts and deforms the bubble; it moves onward, merges with the leaf and travels through the emerging plant.

handoffs.name: Growth leads to wings and release
handoffs.mechanism: The light reaches the bud before petals unfold; those petal paths become flapping wings, and the released stem recoils.

handoffs.name: A gust makes folding useful
handoffs.mechanism: Foliage, clouds and flyer respond to the gust; wings flap faster and then fold into paper facets before the flyer gains ground.

handoffs.name: The arriving star lights the night
handoffs.mechanism: The plane contracts into a star; its trail forms an orbit, the moon brightens and nearby stars appear in a spatial wave.

artwork: The approved six-scene SVG drawings and shape handoffs are retained in a separate composition with causal actions and reactive environment motion. No image generation or singularity imagery.
review_notes: Representative encoded frames and transitional sequences inspected. Scene/hand-off sheets are spaced samples, not every source frame. GIF is a silent 20fps proxy with an artificial loop restart. Technical checks do not establish a creative pass.
